description: Eryilion Sorianarides wears a purple open-front long outer coat with narrow gold geometric woven borders along the front, cuffs and hem. An ivory linen tunic beneath it has matching restrained borders at the round neckline and hem, with pale cuffs visible. A brown leather belt has a round decorated buckle and a long narrow hanging end. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the outfit. His short dark fringe is uncovered.
